title: The Pandas' Hometown
paragraphs: “Sakura, make sure you see Naofumi’s outing through to the end, okay?”
“Boo.”

When Rival has some free time, he also comes over here to eat, thanks to Father giving him a ride. Sakura-chan, of course, responds with a protest. Why are you giving orders to Sakura-chan, anyway? You haven’t become one of the Four Heavenly Kings or anything.

You, on the other hand, should just stick to eating at Shieldfreeden, where poison is laced into every single meal that comes out. I remember you saying that poison has no effect on Gaelion these days.

The Dragon Promotion Faction is also facing increasing threats of attack from hostile forces. Apparently, it’s not the Takt faction, but interference from those who dislike the reforms being pushed by otRival factions. It’s a hopeless situation. Well, I hear their bodyguards are excellent, so there haven’t been any casualties yet.

I hear Rival is working behind the scenes in various ways—partly to expose them—since they say it’s easy to eliminate them as long as they have a pretext. It seems Rival won’t be accompanying Father on his outing this time. It’s just as well he’s not here.
“Father, I’m coming too!”

I have to help Sakura-chan snatch the seat next to Father away from Rival. As for me, Motoyasu, I won’t hold back on helping with that. While Rival is dawdling at Shieldfreeden, let’s win Father’s heart in a big way. Let’s aim for Father ending.
“Hmm… Lord Iwatani, where are you planning to go today?”

Éclair asks about today’s destination. I don’t really have anything that urgent to do either. Over at Shieldfreeden, the talented Filolial-sama—led by Yuki-chan—are taking the initiative with their idol activities, so things are starting to run smoothly even without me.
“Yeah, there’s a place I’d like to visit. I guess it’ll be like a little day trip?”
“A day trip—Elmero’s coming too, right?”
“Of course.”
Kou and Zou are chatting happily.
“So? Where are you going?　“Man, you’re really a diligent sort, aren’t you, Shield Hero?”
Just like Éclair, Panda grumbled to Father about where he wanted to go.
“Well, the place I want to go is…”
Father unfolds a map and points at it, showing Sakura-chan so she can see. It’s the frontier of Siltvelt. I wonder what’s in a place like that?
Oh? Right after pointing there, Panda—who is unmistakably a panda in anyone’s eyes—furrowed his brow.
“Hey, you… Did you ask that guy in the castle town who’s from the same hometown as me? ”

“I’ll leave that to your imagination. Well, according to the folks in Siltvelt, it’s apparently in a neighboring country. It’s also said to be a famous resort. I figured it wouldn’t hurt to take it easy for a bit.”
Father says this in a tone that sounds a bit forced. But so, the panda actually has a fellow townsman, does she? According to Father, it seems they run some kind of shop.
“What if I say I don’t want to go?”
“You don’t have to come, you know? In that case, Lars-chan, just stay at the castle and look after your subordinates.”
“Is there no option to just not go?”
“Do you really think that option is in line with my curiosity to get Shieldfreeden back on its feet?”

Éclair, Zou, me, Sakura-chan, the other Filolial-samas, the castle staff, and our Rival all take turns looking back and forth between Father and Panda. Judging by this exchange, this must be a place connected to Panda. Whether the panda is desperately suppressing his anger or just feeling frustrated, he had his fists clenched, but now he unclenches them as if he’s given up.
“Fine. Ugh… You’re still such a quirky hero, aren’t you!”
“Lars-chan has helped me out in so many ways. He’s been looking after the Filolials and everyone else, so I figured I should at least say hello, right?”
“It’s really not a big deal.”
“I see… So this is Lord Larsa’s hometown, then?”
“It seems so. How did you figure that out?”
“Well, there are various reasons. Apparently, because of Lars-chan’s position and such, the castle staff already ran a background check, so there won’t be any extra expenses.”
“What’s the point of wasting manpower on something like this? Seriously…”

So, an investigation was already underway the moment the panda became Father’s bodyguard. After all, Siltvelt is a nation, isn’t it? After all, the fact that Panda is here in the first place means they’ve already determined there’s no issue.
“I didn’t ask for all the details either, but I should probably at least go file a report, right?”
“I was somewhat prepared for this, but I didn’t expect it to go this far… I’m surprised.”
Panda scratches his head vigorously.
“It’s not like I have any embarrassing past I’d be ashamed to have investigated, or anyone I don’t want him to meet. But it doesn’t exactly make me feel great.”
“It just means they’re taking a keen interest in you, the Shield Hero. You should be proud.”
The representative of the Shusaku race admonishes Panda. So you were here, weren’t you?
“Yeah, yeah. I knew you were here, but this is a hassle.”
Panda waves his hand in a very lazy manner and stands up.
“Well then, shall we get going?”
“Yeah.”
And so, we set off for Panda’s hometown, with Sakura-chan and Kou pulling the carriage.
“So this is Lord Rasa’s hometown…”

As we neared our destination, Éclair got out of the carriage, looked around, and said that. It seemed to be a mountainous region with plenty of bamboo forests. I can’t help but think the terrain looks just like a panda’s natural habitat. The strange part was that we encountered a snow-capped mountain along the way that nearly blocked our path. There were times when Sakura-chan and Kou needed to wear snowshoes. It was so completely white that it was hard to tell Yuki-chan apart from the snow based on the color of her feathers.
“There was a massive snow-capped mountain along the way, but yeah, this area is pretty much what I imagined.”

It’s true—the surroundings are absolutely full of bamboo groves. The mountains are made of sharp rock; it’s just… there’s no other word for it but ‘a hidden paradise.’ It kind of stirs my sense of adventure. Makes me want to switch to Drive Mode.
“Man, even though this is my hometown, I didn’t actually live here when I was old enough to remember. I didn’t come back here until I was pretty grown up.”
“Really?”
“Are you interested in other people’s pasts? You’re quite the curious one, aren’t you?”
“I’d really like to ask you how you ended up becoming a mercenary, Lars-chan. Of course, you don’t have to tell me if you don’t want to.”
“You really are a curious little hero, aren’t you?”
As we chatted like this, we arrived at what looked like the panda’s home village. There we found a large number of villagers, pigs, and pandas.
“Huh? Isn’t that Larsazusa over there!”
One of the pandas called out to the panda standing near us. Let’s make sure to distinguish him from the villager pandas. The villager pandas have a friendly, approachable vibe.
“I heard you pulled off a major feat back in the kingdom—what exactly happened?”
“Ah, thanks to that feat, I landed a job as the Shield Hero’s bodyguard. And it turns out, that Hero is interested in my home.”
“What?!”
The villager panda looked over at Father. It’s obvious at a glance because he’s holding a shield. Father said to the Village Panda:
“I’m Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero. Larsazusa has helped me in many ways, so I came by to thank her.”
“U-um… I’m truly honored, and thank you very much. Um… I’ll go explain this to the villagers for a moment, so please wait here.”
“Sure.”
Looking a bit timid, the villager panda bowed to Father and then dashed off.
“Oh my goodness!　Larsazusa has brought back the Shield Hero in triumph aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”

How should I put it? It’s turned into quite a commotion. A long time ago, when I went to the countryside with the Rich Pig, I encountered a similar incident. Back then, I was treated like her boyfriend and dragged along. Come to think of it, it’s a horrifying memory. Let’s seal it away as a dark chapter in my past, just like Itsuki and Ren often do.
“Sigh… Seriously, this is exactly why I said I didn’t want to come.”
Panda says this while clutching his head.
“So? The Shield Hero? Do you know who he is?　If this ends up putting me in a bad spot, it’ll be hard for me to go back home, you know.”
“I was kind of prepared for this… but I’ll be careful to make sure that doesn’t happen.”
“I’m a little worried about how you plan to be careful, though…”
“It’s getting kind of noisy and fun here, Elmero.”
“I don’t know if it’s fun, but it’s nice to see Larsa looking so surprised.”
“Hey, you…”
The panda glares at the elephant. These two are always like this.
“I’ve heard Larsa’s race is a rare one, but there are more of them than I expected. I thought there was only one family.”
Éclair replies, sounding almost impressed.
“Don’t you think that’s an underestimate?”
“I’m sorry. It’s just that the only member of that rare species I know—or rather, someone I looked up to as a mentor when I was young—is the last surviving member.”
“It wasn’t quite that devastating, though.”
“In a way, you have a deep connection with Lord Iwatani.”
A deep connection with Father, you say? That’s news to me, so I’ll make a mental note of it. It might come in handy someday.
“Huh… What kind of person is he?”
“He’s a descendant of the original species known as the ‘Lizardmen,’ who were companions of the First Shield Hero.”
“That must be quite an impressive person.”

“However, he also died trying to protect Father and the town from the wave’s devastation—pushing himself too hard despite his old age… The wife Father introduced me to, and the child born to them—they’re probably…”
The atmosphere has grown a bit heavy.
“Well, I’ve traveled around the outside world quite a bit myself, and it’s true that I don’t see them very often.”
Panda must have sensed the mood, because she’s changing the subject. All things considered, she’s quite good at being considerate.

“There seem to be quite a few bear Beastmen, though. But pandas are definitely rare, aren’t they? This place might seem like paradise to panda lovers. Though, there are a lot of Demi-Humans here, too.”
“You mean the ones who haven’t mastered Beastman form, right?”
Ah, that’s right—pandas can turn into pigs. Just like Keel. But there are men mixed in there, too. I just can’t help but wonder how that works.
“Hmm?”

Sakura-chan tilts her head slightly as she watches the commotion in the panda settlement. Meanwhile, Father is looking a bit flustered as he deals with villagers who are proposing a village-wide feast. It seems to be a major event for the settlement, and everyone looks a bit nervous.
“Lasa… welcome back…”

Just then, a flashy peacock-like tail and an elderly-looking panda arrived on the scene. The peacock-like Beastman, looking slightly teary-eyed, ran up to the panda. Then they shared a heartfelt embrace.
“Ah… I’m home, Dad. And Grandpa, too.”
“Welcome back. You’ve really grown into a fine young man.”
The elderly panda was carrying a large pipe on his back. Is that a weapon or something? It looks like a blunt instrument.
“It’s nothing like that. It’s just part of my job.”
“Even so… Rasa, everyone here is so happy that you’ve come back alive.”
“Oh, come on…”
The panda seemed a bit uncomfortable as he scratched his head while still in the peacock-like Beastman’s embrace. Then, the elderly panda greeted Father with a Siltvelt-style salute.
“To the Shield Hero and your entire party, we are truly grateful for your visit to our settlement. Please stay as long as you like; we look forward to your company.”
“Yeah, likewise—we look forward to it too.”
Having recently been warned that, as a person in a position of authority, he shouldn’t be too subservient, Father nodded enthusiastically, as if to say, “That’s right.”
“That’s right. Rasa, you must be hungry, right? Since you’re here, you should stay and have some of the food I’ve prepared. Wait here. I’ll make it right away.”
The peacock beastman breaks the embrace and starts to head out to cook. Hmph… Cooking in front of Father—what an unlucky peacock.
“Well, I’m not really that hungry, though…”
“But…”
“Really, I’m fine.”
“I see, I see. I was getting worried since I only got letters from Lars-chan every once in a while, but I’m glad to hear you’re doing well.”
The peacock beastman is nodding along. It seems this peacock beastman hasn’t even noticed Father.
“Um, are you Lars-chan’s father? I’m Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero. Nice to meet you.”

Father, looking a bit hesitant, spoke up and offered his hand. When the peacock beastman looked at him, his expression turned one of utter shock, as if he’d been rendered speechless, before he tentatively shook Father’s hand.
